expected_response.note: No permitted bounded edit is supported by the supplied evidence; the incumbent is retained with its declared FLOWR model, reference and integrator bindings unchanged.

failure_modes: Editing pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend on the basis of pair-kernel, moment, joint-motion or turnover diagnostics would treat a diagnostic feature as an independent force the executing formula does not contain.
Selecting a single region_index from the sign-split landmark soft-min/occupancy contrasts would overstate a heterogeneous, selection-enrichment contrast as a favorable pose direction.

Using the unstable continuous trends (extrapolation_allowed false, polynomial_accepted false, large opposite-sign rates) to justify a temporal teacher blend or temporal region would treat a fitted slope as a stable direction.

Interpreting the turnover residual or the recorded joint-head survival credit as decoded terminal affinity benefit would misstate the label semantics, since decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available is false.
Proposing any temperature change would violate the immutable fixed-parameter policy.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's own evidence shows that the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry; observable_definitions), so the strongest signed contrasts it reports (pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5 positive, pair_kernel_7.0 reversed; endpoint_effects:9-13) are diagnostic only and cannot be connected to an operative reward edit. The landmark soft-min/occupancy contrasts are sign-split and heterogeneous (endpoint_effects:14/15, 29/30/31, 32/33/34), so no single region_index is defensibly favored; the global shape diagonals are negative (endpoint_effects:3/4/5/8) but again have no executing term. The centroid evidence is weak and not reproducible across strata (endpoint_effects:1 versus branch_adjusted:77/78/79 and 231/232/233), so no translation direction is supported. The increment table disagrees with the endpoint table (increment_effects:10/13, 14/15, 3/4/7), so the endpoint direction is not simply the within-path direction. The joint-motion summaries are the most reproducible negative signals (branch_adjusted:74/75/76, 151/152/153, 228/229/230, 305/306/307) but are explicitly not a coordinate gradient or trajectory velocity force. The continuous trends are unstable (extrapolation_allowed false and polynomial_accepted false for every row; large opposite-sign first/last rates and multiple sign changes in continuous:0-19), and the curve_support audit reports relative node RMSE 0.386-0.931 with legendre_runtime_allowed false, so no time-conditioned teacher blend or temporal region is defensibly supported. Teacher provenance is fixed (teacher_modes: 28 teachers, temperature_edits false; fixed_parameters mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0), and the incumbent already uses teacher_neighbors 4 and pointcloud_delta_A 1.0. No registered bounded edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first objective, so retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; deferring is unnecessary because the evidence is sufficient to conclude that no permitted edit is supported.
